headline: One clear workspace for questions, files, research and creation.
copy: JT-Code is the only assistant name used throughout this platform. The web client is React and TypeScript; authentication is handled by Supabase Auth and all business state lives in the Django API.
feature1Desc: Supabase Auth sessions are verified again by Django before every protected action.
feature2Desc: Supabase-hosted PostgreSQL remains the transactional source of truth.
feature3Desc: Signed Cloudinary uploads keep secrets outside the browser.
